## Database gate
- No migration, Ent schema, entity-field, or SQL path change exists in the official `vendor-0.2.5^{commit}` to `v0.2.7^{commit}` increment.
- The candidate database exception ledger was rebuilt against `vendor-0.2.7`; its 95 rows are the already-reviewed Custom database/Ent surface, not new official database changes.
- Candidate database fingerprint: `8282e352aae3e2e212bf4374bb80b92a277608fd3cdd3209bf1ef8cda3e094d4`.
- No production DDL/DML was executed. This official increment requires no new production migration SQL.

## Conflict resolution
- `backend/internal/handler/gemini_v1beta_handler.go`: retained official dynamic Antigravity/native model discovery and metadata while preserving Custom allowlist, display-list, access-policy, and blocklist filtering; removed the duplicate mapping declaration and kept nil-safe test construction.
- `backend/internal/service/antigravity_gateway_gemini.go`: retained official Gemini thinking-variant resolution and Custom final resolved-model access enforcement; `countTokens` continues to avoid premature model mapping.
- `frontend/src/components/payment/AmountInput.vue`: retained Custom currency/minor-unit behavior and adopted official restoration of the last valid value after invalid input.
- `frontend/src/views/admin/__tests__/ChannelMonitorView.grok.spec.ts`: retained the provider-count assertion derived from `PROVIDERS.length` instead of hard-coding the current official count.
- `.gitignore`: added the whitelist entry for the official tracked `docs/seedance-api.md`, so candidate-tree reconstruction does not drop that upstream file.
- `backend/internal/service/wire.go` and generated `backend/cmd/server/wire_gen.go`: replaced the fragile generated-file-only PluginManager account-directory injection with a Wire provider and explicit interface binding; generated output now preserves the same Custom capability.

## Validation

- No unmerged path remains after semantic conflict resolution.

- Focused backend regression: Gemini native/list-model, thinking-variant, and final model-access guard tests passed in `internal/handler` and `internal/service`.
- Candidate tree: `d977c3ad82a104da1ef750788de14343914f4eab`.
- Candidate-tree and delta ledger: passed, 640 decisions bound to `aea725f2ea644d5592d0bbb1d63b607efa7e200a`.

- Database boundary: passed with fingerprint `8282e352aae3e2e212bf4374bb80b92a277608fd3cdd3209bf1ef8cda3e094d4`; `database_changed=true` reflects the existing Custom exception surface and does not identify an official v0.2.5-to-v0.2.7 migration.

- Backend: `go generate ./cmd/server`, `go test ./...`, and `go build ./cmd/server` passed.

Full Vitest ran 337 files / 2471 tests: 2469 passed and 2 inherited official `SubscriptionsView.userUsageLink.spec.ts` assertions failed because the official request now includes `allow_bulk_quota_reset`; the test file is unchanged by this upgrade and was not modified to hide the mismatch.
